alex (CEO): @here Quick heads-up — Town Hall tomorrow 10:00am PT. Will be ~50 mins + 10m open Q&A. Main agenda: 1) Q1 highlights & metrics, 2) Product roadmap priorities, 3) Dedicated/Private launch timeline, 4) Reliability/ops ask, 5) Q&A. Drop questions below or use the form. :megaphone:
rachel (People Ops): Calendar invite updated with Zoom + captions. If you need accomodation, DM me. Recording will be posted after the meeting. Link to add questions: https://redwood-internal/forms/townhall-qna :spiral_calendar:
maya (VP Product): We'll demo the Optimize flow (autosuggested batching + quantization presets) and show canary rollout plan. If you have a specific customer case, paste it here and I'll add it to the demo runbook.
sam (Head of Eng): Pre-reads: short notes + key metrics here: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/townhall/apr-pre-read.pdf Please skim 2 slides on latency/cost tradeoffs. If you spot anything that looks off, flag it in-thread.
jordan (SRE): Q: For the Dedicated rollout, will we be changing default autoscale policies for existing customers or only new capacity?
alex (CEO): Short answer: only new capacity by default. We will offer an opt-in migration window and communicate a month in advance. Bigger migration paths will be handled project-by-project.
maya (VP Product): Adding detail: opt-in rollout, 3-week migration test window, ability to pin old policies for 30 days post-migration. We'll publish a migration checklist in #eng-ops.
jordan (SRE): thx — can we include a simple config diff in the checklist? e.g.:
```
old_scale: period=60s
new_scale: period=30s, burst=2x
```
that helps oncall triage.
sam (Head of Eng): Good call. We'll add the diff + recommended observability queries.
rachel (People Ops): Logistics: snacks catered for those in SF office, remote folks get lunch stipend. If you'd like to ask an anonymous question, use the form above or email all-hands@redwood.ai. :bento:
all-hands-bot: Recording will be uploaded to the #all-hands channel and Drive within 1 hour after the meeting. Tags: townhall, recording, april.
alex (CEO): TL;DR: strong quarter, priority is reliability + predictable unit cost as we scale Dedicated and Private. Expect a product milestone in ~3 weeks; ops and support will get a heads-up 48h before rollout. Bring your customer anecdotes to Qs. :rocket:
maya (VP Product): If you can't attend live but want your question asked live, paste it here and mark it with [ASK-LIVE]. We'll queue it into the Q&A.
alex (CEO): See you all tomorrow. 10:00am PT sharp. Recording/notes + action items will be posted after. :calendar:
